key.headline: Yes, with cleaning and extra compression
key.request: Get the unit to 120% of today's throughput. Find every equipment item that limits it and propose the cheapest change for each, verified in DWSIM, within every utility and frame limit on the data sheet. Where a limit needs new equipment, propose it as added equipment with its rating source, not by changing an existing rating.
